resources.name: Kudos API
resources.description:
Requests for every Kudos route, grouped by area, with assertions on status codes, headers and key fields.

Run the folders in order (they share one session). The run signs in once as the seeded demo owner, creates one space with a unique name, exercises it, deletes it and signs out, so it leaves no data behind. Free plan: if the demo owner already has a space the create is refused with a redirect to /billing and the dependent requests skip themselves.

Folder 99 only runs with runOptional=true. See docs/api/README.md.

resources.name: 12 Client logs
resources.description: Browser log intake. Open endpoint without CSRF; 60 requests per minute. Same-origin browsers only: the request must carry Sec-Fetch-Site (same-origin or none) or an Origin header whose host equals the request host. Scripts that send neither are refused.

resources.description:

Mode: json. Expected status: 403.

resources.name: POST /client-logs with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site is 403
resources.description:
When Sec-Fetch-Site is present it decides, even if Origin looks right.

Mode: json. Expected status: 403.

resources.name: POST /client-logs with neither Origin nor Sec-Fetch-Site is 403
resources.description:
Plain scripts (curl, newman without an Origin header) are refused on purpose.

Mode: json. Expected status: 403.
